page.overview:
Who is Brace Tarkosa's institute instructor?

A male institute instructor instructed the Human Brace Tarkosa. several of the instructor's students entered his office and dismantled his desk, which they rebuilt in a refresher station. Tarkosa believed that once the teacher saw the desk in the refresher, he would be apoplectic. In 27 BBY, Tarkosa compared the teacher to Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth, which the Human and his colleagues believed was while aboard the Galactic Republic exploration and colonization vessel Outbound Flight.

The institute instructor was mentioned in Timothy Zahn's 2006 novel Outbound Flight.
